guide.summary: A pretend chemical that slows and harms only algae.
guide.biology: Some real substances harm light-using life more than other microbes; this made-up chemical stands in for that broad idea.
guide.rules: Adds an abstract inhibitor that dissolves, diffuses and loses 0.2 % of its amount each tick. It targets only the algae A01 Sunbead, A02 Glasswheel, A03 Shadeleaf, A04 Turnleaf and A05 Raftball. A target's exposure is the local amount, halved once in a cell with biofilm; its growth is multiplied by 1 / (1 + exposure) and it loses 8 times the exposure in health each second. Bacteria, yeasts, fungi, consumers, parasites and viruses are unaffected. No additional modeled reaction. This is an abstract game mechanic, not a claim about how any real product works.
guide.example: Dose a crowded Sunbead patch and compare the oxygen overlay before and after.
